evidence.reason: The repair suppression at line 198 can skip enrollment whenever the head range since the newest captured head contains only owned repairs, without checking whether the captured evidence used the current pin base. On a PR retarget to an older allowed base, the added base range is not covered by previous..head, and the later equivalence check that would detect the changed base is bypassed by the earlier continue. The suppression should be limited to evidence whose base matches the current pin, or otherwise fall through to the equivalence/delta enrollment path.
